customManagers.description: The guest's OpenSSH. Mavergreen/openssh publishes two product archives per release; mavericks-media reads their names out of the release's SHA256SUMS, so a renamed asset prefix cannot 404 across this bump.

OpenCore, built from pinned source (Tier 0). The version appears once in the URL, so no autoReplaceStringTemplate is needed. The sha256 in the next column is NOT something Renovate can compute -- .github/workflows/ci.yml re-verifies every changed assets/pins/sources.tsv line, so the bump PR stays red until the checksum is pinned with it. See INGREDIENTS.md.

Lilu, an acidanthera release binary injected by OpenCore (Tier 1). The version appears TWICE in one URL, so the whole match is rewritten from a template -- a manager that replaced only the captured occurrence would leave a half-updated URL that 404s.
VirtualSMC, the SMC emulation kext OpenCore injects (Tier 1). Same two-occurrences-in-one-URL shape as Lilu.

packageRules.description: A boot-stack bump changes what every future guest boots, and every guest and box already built stops being what the repository would build, with nothing going red. It also arrives with a sha256 nobody has recomputed. So these land by hand, with a read of the upstream release notes and a re-pinned checksum. This is the 'builds fine and is wrong' exception the shared preset asks for a reason for.
